# quickwit_field_datetime (Data Source)

Builds a `datetime` field mapping. The index `timestamp_field` must be a single-valued fast datetime field.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Field name. Dots must be escaped (`\\.`) to be part of the name.

### Optional

- `array` (Boolean) Map an array of values (`array<T>`). Defaults to `false`.
- `description` (String) Free-form description of the field.
- `fast` (Boolean) Store the field in a columnar fast field (sorting, aggregations). Defaults to `false`.
- `fast_precision` (String) Precision of the fast field. Defaults to `seconds`.
- `indexed` (Boolean) Index the field (make it searchable). Defaults to `true`.
- `input_formats` (List of String) Accepted input formats: `rfc3339`, `rfc2822`, `iso8601`, `unix_timestamp` or a strptime pattern. Defaults to `["rfc3339", "unix_timestamp"]`.
- `output_format` (String) Output format in search results: `rfc3339`, `rfc2822`, `iso8601`, `unix_timestamp_secs|millis|micros|nanos` or a strptime pattern. Defaults to `rfc3339`.
- `stored` (Boolean) Store the value in the doc store. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) Canonical JSON document (all defaults explicit, keys sorted), as returned by Quickwit.
